title: aster albescens var. glabratus
intro: Aster albescens var. glabratus, commonly known as White Sagebrush, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to the Great Plains region of North America. The plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. Therapeutically, Aster albescens var. glabratus is used to treat conditions like wounds, fever, and respiratory issues, as well as to reduce pain and inflammation. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
